name: How do you determine the market value of a luxury condo?

mainEntity.name: How do you determine the market value of a luxury condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining the market value of a luxury condo involves a comprehensive analysis that goes beyond standard comparable sales. We consider unique architectural features, bespoke finishes, exclusive amenities, and specific views. For example, a condo in Fisher Island or Bal Harbour will have different value drivers than one in Brickell. Kelby Contreras provides a detailed comparative market analysis (CMA), focusing on recent sales of truly comparable luxury properties within your specific micro-market to ensure an accurate and competitive listing price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Market value for luxury condos is determined by analyzing unique features, amenities, and comparable high-end sales in your specific location.
